FREELANCE SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Freelance Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is made as of the Effective Date written on the signature page, between Harborline Studio Ltd., a private limited company (the "Client"), and Marisol Quintero-Baines, a sole trader (the "Contractor").

1. SERVICES

1.1 The Contractor will perform the services described in each statement of work the parties sign (each, a "Statement of Work"). A Statement of Work sets out the deliverables, the schedule, and the fee.

1.2 A Statement of Work takes effect only when both parties have signed it. A change to the scope, schedule, or fee of a Statement of Work takes effect only when both parties have agreed the change in writing.

1.3 The Contractor decides how, when, and where the services are performed, provided the deliverables arrive by the dates in the Statement of Work.

1.4 The Contractor will supply its own equipment and software. Where the Client asks the Contractor to buy something specific for the project, the Client will reimburse the cost at the price agreed in advance.

2. ACCEPTANCE

2.1 The Client will confirm acceptance of a deliverable, or set out in writing what is missing against the Statement of Work, within seven (7) days of receiving it.

2.2 If the Client does not respond within those seven (7) days, the deliverable is treated as accepted.

2.3 The Contractor will correct anything the Client identifies under Section 2.1 at no extra charge, up to two rounds of corrections per deliverable. Further rounds are charged at the hourly rate in the Statement of Work.

3. FEES AND PAYMENT

3.1 The Client will pay the fees set out in the Statement of Work. Fees are exclusive of value added tax, which the Contractor will add where it applies.

3.2 The Contractor will invoice on acceptance of each deliverable, or monthly for work in progress where the Statement of Work says so.

3.3 The Client will pay each invoice within fourteen (14) days of the invoice date.

3.4 Interest accrues on any overdue amount at 1.5% per month, calculated daily from the due date until the Client pays, and the Contractor may pause work on written notice while an invoice is more than fourteen (14) days overdue.

3.5 The Client will reimburse pre-approved expenses within the same fourteen (14) days, against receipts.

4. TERM

4.1 This Agreement starts on the Effective Date and runs until the parties complete the last open Statement of Work, unless it ends earlier under Section 5.

4.2 This Agreement does not renew on its own. The parties may extend it, or start a new term, only by signing a written extension.

5. TERMINATION

5.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement, or any individual Statement of Work, on thirty (30) days of prior written notice to the other party.

5.2 Either party may terminate immediately on written notice if the other party commits a material breach and has not put it right within fifteen (15) days of being told about it in writing.

5.3 On termination for any reason, the Client will pay for every deliverable already accepted and, pro rata, for work in progress at the date notice takes effect, against an invoice the Contractor issues within fourteen (14) days.

5.4 On termination the Contractor will hand over the work the Client has paid for, in the file formats named in the Statement of Work, and each party will return or delete the other party's confidential information on request.

6. OWNERSHIP OF WORK PRODUCT

6.1 The Contractor owns the work product it creates until the Client has paid in full for it.

6.2 On receipt of full payment for a deliverable, the Contractor assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in that deliverable, and will sign any document reasonably needed to record the assignment.

6.3 The Contractor keeps ownership of the tools, libraries, and general know-how it brought to the project, and grants the Client a perpetual, non-exclusive licence to use those materials as part of the deliverables.

6.4 The Contractor may show the work product in a portfolio or case study once the Client has made it public, or earlier with the Client's written consent.

7. CONFIDENTIALITY

7.1 Each party will hold the other party's confidential information in confidence and will use it only as this Agreement requires.

7.2 Confidential information does not include information that is already public, that the receiving party held before it was disclosed, or that the receiving party develops on its own.

7.3 The obligations in this Section 7 continue for two (2) years after this Agreement ends.

8. WARRANTIES

8.1 The Contractor warrants that it will perform the services with reasonable skill and care, and that the deliverables are its own work and do not knowingly infringe anyone else's rights.

8.2 The Client warrants that it has the right to give the Contractor any material it supplies for use in the deliverables.

9. INDEMNITY AND LIABILITY

9.1 Each party will indemnify the other against third party claims that arise from its own breach of Section 8.

9.2 The total liability of each party to the other under this Agreement, however it arises, is capped at the total fees paid under the Statement of Work the claim relates to.

9.3 Neither party is liable to the other for loss of profit, loss of revenue, or indirect loss.

9.4 The cap in Section 9.2 does not apply to a party's own fraud.

10. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR STATUS

10.1 The Contractor is an independent contractor and is free to work for other clients during the term, including clients in the same industry as the Client.

10.2 Nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, agency, or employment relationship between the parties.

10.3 The Contractor may use a subcontractor with the Client's prior written consent, and stays responsible for the subcontractor's work.

11. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTES

11.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

11.2 The courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of this Agreement. Before starting a claim, each party will give the other fourteen (14) days to settle the matter by discussion.

12. GENERAL

12.1 A notice under this Agreement must be in writing and sent to the email address each party names on the signature page.

12.2 This Agreement, together with every Statement of Work signed under it, is the whole of what the parties have agreed on this subject.

12.3 If a provision of this Agreement is held invalid, the rest stays in full force.

12.4 Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other party's written consent.

12.5 This Agreement may be signed in counterparts, including by electronic signature, and each counterpart is an original.
